items.scope: Vulnerability assignment related to its vulnerability coordination role.
Foxit issues only.
Pandora FMS, Pandora ITSM, and Pandora RC issues only.
All Payara Platform product distributions (Payara Server, Micro, Embedded) for both Enterprise (commercial) and Community (OSS) distributions.
Dell, Dell EMC, and VCE issues only.
Bosch products only.
Palantir products and technologies only.
Yokogawa Group companies’ products and Yokogawa Group subsidiaries’ products.
Third-party products it researches.
Teltonika Networks products and services only.
Open Design Alliance products only.
Vulnerabilities in supported Ivanti products and infrastructure, excluding third-party components, and meeting severity thresholds defined in Ivanti’s Disclosure Policy found here.
Thinkst Applied Research’s products only.
Vulnerabilities in Snyk products and vulnerabilities discovered by, or reported to, Snyk that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Xerox Corporation issues only.

Vulnerabilities in Protect AI products, third-party code vulnerabilities reported by researchers collaborating with huntr and vulnerabilities discovered by, or reported to, Protect AI that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities for OTRS and ((OTRS)) Community Edition and modules only.

All products of Medtronic or a Medtronic company including supported products and end-of-life/end-of-service products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered in Medtronic products that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Third-party products he researches that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Siemens issues only.

CVEs requested by code owners using the GitHub Security Advisories feature and vulnerabilities affecting open source projects discovered by security researchers at GitHub or Microsoft not covered by another CNA’s scope.
AMD branded products and technologies only.
Hanwha Vision (formerly Samsung Techwin and Hanwha Techwin) products and solutions only, including end-of-life (EOL).
All products of 2N Telekomunikace a.s. including end-of-life/end-of-service products.
All Rapid7 products, and vulnerabilities discovered by Rapid7 that are not in another CNA’s scope.

All BeyondTrust products, including PasswordSafe, Privileged Remote Access, Remote Support, Privilege Management for Windows/Mac, Privilege Management for Unix/Linux, Identity Security Insights, Active Directory (AD) Bridge, and Total PASM.
All Mattermost issues, and vulnerabilities discovered by Mattermost that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Intel branded products and technologies and Intel managed open source projects.
Zabbix products and Zabbix projects listed on https://git.zabbix.com/ only.
All Honeywell products.
Vulnerabilities in Intigriti products and vulnerabilities discovered by, or reported to, Intigriti that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Zyxel products issues only.
All HYPR products only.
ASR products only.
All ESET products only and vulnerabilities discovered by ESET that are not covered by another CNA’s scope.
End of life open source projects supported by HeroDevs if hosted on HeroDevs.com, or issues in open source projects discovered by or reported to HeroDevs, unless covered by the scope of another CNA.
All upKeeper Solutions products, excluding end-of-life (EOL) as listed in the upKeeper Solutions End of Life Policy.
Hitachi Energy products only.
All currently supported PTC software products and cloud/SaaS services.
Roche’s medical technology products.
GitHub Enterprise Server issues only.
All Cato Networks products and vulnerabilities in third-party products affecting Cato products unless covered by the scope of another CNA.
Lexmark products only.
Acer issues only.
Vulnerabilities in OpenAI installed software including desktop apps, mobile apps, and SDKs only.
Vulnerabilities in PHP code (code in https://github.com/php/php-src) only.
Jamf issues and Jamf Open Source.

All Trellix Enterprise (formerly McAfee Enterprise and FireEye) products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Trellix Advanced Research Center (Trellix ACR) that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Software vulnerabilities related to the TianoCore Open Source.
Vulnerabilities in runZero products, as well as vulnerabilities discovered by, or reported to, runZero that are not in another CNA’s scope.
